summary: Git-backed routing, context compilation, durable memory, skill discovery, and handoff infrastructure for coding agents.
current_priorities: Follow projects/personal-agent-os/roadmap/master-priority-roadmap.md as the canonical implementation order. Reduce model/Work usage before expanding feature scope.
Implement selective profile/context retrieval with compact context packets, relevance filtering, deduplication, privacy enforcement, provenance, and measurable context-size diagnostics.

Implement shared document intelligence: local persistent extraction/OCR cache, embedded-text-first routing, dependency-aware invalidation, template reuse, targeted field-zone OCR, and strict work-data privacy boundaries.

Generalize restart-safe checkpoints, stable IDs, fingerprinting, deduplication, and incremental processing for long-running imports/crawls including iCloud Mail, Drive archive work, text imports, document batches, and future knowledge ingestion.
Operationalize deterministic/cache/approved-skill-first execution before model calls.

Add privacy-safe local usage telemetry and reporting, then provider-neutral adaptive routing with validator-driven escalation. Treat external API delegation as optional separately billed capacity, not the first savings mechanism.
Mine repeated workflows into deterministic automations first and reviewed reusable skills second, using replay/evaluation before promotion.

After the usage-economy foundation is working, implement the Personal Executive roadmap: Event Bus, Next Action Engine, capture/rescue, prioritization, delegation, communication/calendar intelligence, proactivity, voice, and controlled autonomy.

Keep Knowledge Library / Elder Scrolls and Lorekeeper / creative intelligence as later reusable systems that inherit selective retrieval, incremental ingestion, caching, provenance, and routing from the economy foundation.
constraints: Canonical state must remain reviewable in Git.
Do not preload raw history or all project content.
A third-party MCP must not claim to hot-swap the host model already running inside ChatGPT Work or Claude; use pre-routing, delegation, and Agent-OS-owned escalation instead.
